body.x: LOS ANGELES, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Logic Wireless unveiled its 2G projector phone 'Logic Bolt V 1.5' which produces images of native 640×480 resolution up to 64-inche in screen size.
Logic Wireless debuted the Logic Bolt V 1.0 at the CES 2009, which contained the first ever phone-integrated projector capable of projecting phone media content on any surface up to 60-inche.

Adopting a 2.6-inch QVGA display, the Bolt V 1.5 features 3M camera, 1M front camera, media player, FM radio, TV tuner, text viewer, microSD card slots, Bluetooth, Symbian OS support. It also offers up to 3 hours of talking time, 200-250 hours of standby, and 2 hours of projector mode.
The Logic Bolt V 1.5 is scheduled to present at the upcoming Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2010 in Las Vegas on January 6th, 2010.
